Your SSA-45/resume must provide sufficient experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and proficiency of any required competencies to perform the specific position for which you are applying.

Your SSA-45/resume is the key means we have for evaluating your experience, education, knowledge, skills, abilities and competencies as they relate to this position. Your resume and supporting documents must specifically address the evaluation criteria for the position.

Describe duties you perform (not just knowledge, skills and abilities) as they relate to the specialized experience required for this position.

Be clear, accurate and specific when describing your experience; e.g., list all positions separately, include full start and stop dates for each position, your component and grade, and a comprehensive description the relevant duties you performed in each position.

YOUR RESUME OR SSA-45 MUST INCLUDE YOUR OFFICIAL DUTY STATION AND YOUR ORGANIZATION (I.E., SECURITY AND RESILIENCY) OR YOU MAY BE FOUND INELIGIBLE.

To qualify for the 2210 IT Specialist series, the applicant must demonstrate the following competencies: Attention to Detail (Level 4, Advanced) - Is thorough when performing work and conscientious about attending to detail.

Customer Service (Level 4, Advanced) - Works with clients and customers (that is, any individuals who use or receive the services or products that your work unit produces, including the general public, individuals who work in the agency, other agencies, or organizations outside the Government) to assess their needs, provide information or assistance, resolve their problems, or satisfy their expectations; knows about available products and services; is committed to providing quality products and services.

Decision Making (Level 3, Intermediate) - Makes sound, well-informed, and objective decisions; perceives the impact and implications of decisions; commits to action, even in uncertain situations, to accomplish organizational goals; causes change.

Information Management (Level 4, Advanced) - Identifies a need for and knows where or how to gather information; organizes and maintains information or information management systems.

Interpersonal Skills (Level 4, Advanced) - Shows understanding, friendliness, courtesy, tact, empathy, concern, and politeness to others; develops and maintains effective relationships with others; may include effectively dealing with individuals who are difficult, hostile, or distressed; relates well to people from varied backgrounds and different situations.

Oral Communication (Level 3, Intermediate) - Expresses information (for example, ideas or facts) to individuals or groups effectively, taking into account the audience and nature of the information (for example, technical, sensitive, controversial); makes clear and convincing oral presentations; listens to others, attends to nonverbal cues, and responds appropriately.

Problem Solving (Level 4, Advanced) - Identifies problems; determines accuracy and relevance of information; uses sound judgment to generate and evaluate alternatives, and to make recommendations.

Teamwork (Level 4, Advanced) - Encourages and facilitates cooperation, pride, trust, and group identity; fosters commitment and team spirit; works with others to achieve goals.

Technical Competence (Level 4, Advanced) - Uses knowledge that is acquired through formal training or on-the-job experience to perform one's job; works with, understands, and evaluates technical information related to the job; advises others on technical issues.

Specialized Experience: Applicants must have specialized experience that is directly related to the work of the position and have equipped them with the competencies required to successfully perform the duties of the role.

These knowledge, skills, and abilities/competencies are normally attained through the equivalent of one year of specialized experience equivalent to the next lower grade level of the position being filled. To qualify at the GS-15 level, you must have specialized experience at the GS-14 level, or equivalent.

This experience must demonstrate proficiency in the following: Designing, developing, and maintaining large-scale web applications and APIs, utilizing advanced frameworks such as Angular, React.js, and Spring Boot, and programming languages such as Java or Node.js on platforms like AWS or PaaS., Object-oriented software design and implementation, including interfacing with databases such as DB2, SQL, MongoDB, and PostgreSQL, as well as leveraging DevOps technologies to meet modern development standards, Leading and coordinating complex enterprise-level IT projects, facilitating technical discussions and conducting code reviews, Collaborating with cross-functional teams to define, design, and deliver new features, and Communicating complex technical concepts to executives and team members.

The specialized experience is REQUIRED and must be explicitly documented/described in your resume, or you will be disqualified from further consideration.

Qualification standards and additional information for this position can be found here: Competency-Based Qualification Standard for the Information Technology Management Series, 2210 NOTE: You cannot be credited for experience unless you clearly show your grade level at the time the experience was gained, as well as the dates you were at that grade level.

If you combine career-ladder experience into a single description of duties, you may be eliminated from consideration based on failure to clearly document the required experience at the required grade level for the required period of time. Qualification requirements must be met by the closing date of this announcement.

Applicants for promotion must have 52 weeks at GS-14. Time in grade requirement must be met by the closing date of this announcement.

T-Rex Solutions is seeking a talented SharePoint Engineer to support the Office of the Comptroller of Currency (OCC) by delivering robust solutions to modernize, enhance, and maintain the OCC’s SharePoint environment.

This individual will bring extensive experience in SharePoint Online, SharePoint migrations, and a customer-centric approach to deliver enterprise collaboration solutions.

The SharePoint Engineer will be responsible for designing and implementing SharePoint solutions to improve team collaboration, document management, and information sharing within the OCC.

This role will also focus on migrating existing content and workflows to SharePoint Online, working to ensure a smooth and secure transition while maintaining high user satisfaction. Responsibilities: Design, configure, and manage SharePoint Online environments, ensuring optimal performance, reliability, and security.

Create and manage SharePoint sites, libraries, lists, permissions, and content structures based on business requirements. Use modern SharePoint features such as Power Automate, Power Apps, and SPFx to deliver customized and streamlined solutions.

Plan and execute migrations from legacy SharePoint platforms (e.g., 2013/2016/2019) to SharePoint Online. Utilize tools such as ShareGate, Metalogix, or native SharePoint migration tools to ensure efficient and secure content migration with minimal disruption.

Validate and troubleshoot migration outcomes, resolving any issues related to data integrity, permissions, or configurations. Work closely with the OCC technical teams, business users, and other stakeholders to gather and refine requirements for SharePoint solutions.

Provide consultative advice on best practices for SharePoint architecture, integrations, and governance. Develop and enforce governance models for content management, site usage, and permissions in alignment with OCC policies and compliance requirements. Create and maintain technical and end-user documentation for SharePoint solutions and workflows.

Perform ongoing support, patching, and upgrades within the SharePoint Online environment. Resolve technical issues in collaboration with SAIC and OCC teams, ensuring seamless operation for end-users.

Requirements: Bachelor's Degree with 8+ years of progressive IT experience OR an Associate's Degree with 10+ years OR 12+ years of equivalent IT experience US Citizenship and must be able to obtain a public trust clearance. Minimum of 5 years of experience as a SharePoint Engineer, including expertise in SharePoint Online and migrations.

Strong knowledge of SharePoint Online architecture, capabilities, and configuration. Proven experience with SharePoint migrations using tools such as ShareGate, Metalogix, or other migration platforms. Proficiency in Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps) and SharePoint Framework (SPFx).

Strong understanding of Office 365 environment integrations including Teams, OneDrive, and Azure AD. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. Ability to work independently and with a team in a fast-paced environment while adapting to changing priorities. Strong customer service mindset with a focus on end-user satisfaction.

Desired Skills: Experience with Treasury or IRS systems is a plus Familiarity with compliance requirements such as NIST, FISMA, and FedRAMP in the context of SharePoint.

Few people get to build a bank from scratch. Even fewer get to build one at a moment when banking itself is being reinvented.
The Dollar is the best product in the history of the world - there is infinite global demand.

But International Fintechs and non-US banks are left with two unsatisfying options to access it: Either they build on legacy clearing banks that are slow and unreliable, or they interface with middleware providers that don’t move and hold the dollars directly, but themselves rely on underlying legacy banks.

Augustus collapses this stack by combining two things: A real, national bank charter (in organization), and Marble, our proprietary core banking system, built around intelligence, made of code.
We are a group of operators, unicorn early employees, ex-founders and people who walked away from degrees because they believe this is an industry and career defining opportunity. We are backed with more than $200M from Peter Thiel's Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Hummingbird, QED, Creandum, and the founders of Nubank, Ramp, Deel, Circle, Fluidstack, Fuse, and n8n.
We are regulated in Europe and live with Euro and Stablecoin clearing today. Now, we are building the US team from the ground up, while continuing to grow rapidly in Europe.

You're a super IC in a small, elite engineering team. You work on core banking systems and own projects end to end. You take on big projects, drive them yourself, and deliver.
You work with engineering, product, and clients. You turn complex financial problems into clean code. You're trusted with the big calls from day 1; system design, technical tradeoffs, what we build and what we don't. The team is small on purpose, that means you have a lot of ownership, you move fast, and you make decisions that actually matter.
You're part of the product engineering team building the Programmable Bank - a bank for the new age of money movement, built around Digital Assets and AI. Your team builds the banking core across bare metal central bank infrastructure and blockchain infrastructure. We're building a Swiss clock: your job is precision engineering, translating a complex system into simple, clean code that runs reliably at scale.
Your First Six Months
Understand the codebase and increase your ownership rapidly.
Months 1-2: You ramp up fast. Understand the codebase, the domain, the product and ship meaningful code in your first weeks. Pick up a major project as an IC and start driving it. You're pairing with the team but operating independently early.
Months 3-4: You've shipped your first big project end to end. You know the domain well enough to push back on product decisions when something doesn't make sense. You're starting to influence technical direction - how we model data, how we handle edge cases, where we take shortcuts and where we don't.
Months 5-6: You're one of the people the team relies on for the hardest problems. You scope and drive projects autonomously. You have strong opinions on how the core banking systems should evolve and you're acting on them. Junior engineers come to you because your code is clean and your thinking is clear.
Who Will Thrive At Augustus
We believe that throwing smart people with high agency at big problems produces the best outcomes. The people who succeed here share the following traits:
Relentless: You can't leave something broken. You don't stop because it got hard or because no one is watching.
Set The Bar: You're harder on yourself than anyone else would be. You don't need external accountability to care about quality.
Shape The Game: You don't wait for a playbook and you don't need one. You walk into genuinely new territory and figure it out. You move before anyone asked you to.
Systems First: You don't solve problems by adding people or effort. You build systems that make the problem smaller. Your first instinct is to automate, not to handle it manually.

s.h: This role is for you if
s.t:
Your former teammates would put you in the top 5% of engineers they've worked with - your code is clean, correct, and easy to delete.
You merge your PR today, not tomorrow. You ship and iterate rather than wait for perfection.
You want to build core banking systems that handle real money, not another CRUD app.
You care about simplicity more than cleverness.
You'd rather own a problem end to end than wait for someone to hand you a spec.
You want to work alongside people who are genuinely great at what they do.

s.h: This is not for you if
s.t:
You think that a new fancy pattern or architecture principle will solve all your problems.
You think "that's not my problem" is an acceptable answer.
You can not follow other team member’s decisions.
You are closing your macbook at 5pm sharp and don’t care about your work.
You are not passionate about what you do.

Compensation packages at Augustus include base salary, equity, and benefits. New hire offers are made based on a candidate's experience, expertise and geographic location. The annual base salary range for this role is €100,000-€150,000 + equity.

Career Growth: You will be given more responsibility and pushed to grow faster than ever before.

Meet DeepL
DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.
Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.
What sets us apart
What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.
When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.
What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL on LinkedIn , Instagram , and our Blog .

s.h: MMeet the team behind this journey
s.t:
DeepL is not just a translation tool; we are building the Operating System for Global Communication . We are the rare AI company that builds the entire stack in-house: from training next-gen LLMs on our own NVIDIA DGX SuperPODs to delivering real-time Language AI to over 300 million users and 200,000+ businesses globally.
You will join the API Enterprise team. We sit at the intersection of DeepL's API platform and our Enterprise ecosystem.

Whereas the Core team obsesses over the self-service developer journey, our focus is on enterprise customer adoption: the usage insights, cost controls, RBAC , compliance, and data residency capabilities that enterprise IT and security teams depend on.

We work hand-in-hand with a wide set of stakeholder teams to make DeepL's API the obvious and safe choice for global enterprises.
We are shifting gears. We are moving from "Software-First" to "Product-First." We don't hire engineers to just close tickets or optimize algorithms in isolation. We hire Missionaries—builders who obsess over the Why before the How.

Drive Enterprise API Adoption: You will own the features that turn enterprise interest into deep, durable adoption. Examples include usage insights, cost and consumption controls, and the governance tooling that lets large organizations understand and manage how they use DeepL's APIs.
Build for Governance & Compliance: You will design the controls enterprise IT and security admins rely on (roles and permissions, projects, data residency, and audit-ability), making DeepL the compliant default for regulated, global organizations.
Guardianship of Quality & Production Reliability: You will own your services end-to-end, including participation in the API on-call rotation, with a shared goal of taking our public API to four nines of reliability. You will implement strong contract testing, monitoring, and SLOs, preventing breaking changes and security vulnerabilities before they reach our enterprise customers.
Architect Across the Enterprise Ecosystem: You will work deep within DeepL's existing technical and organizational structures, navigating dependencies across different areas and many stakeholder teams to ship cohesive, reliable enterprise capabilities.
Qualities we look for
An "Enterprise-First" Mindset: You treat enterprise IT and security admins as your primary users. You understand that earning their trust means clear governance, predictable cost control, robust compliance, fast response times and data residency. You're a strong communicator who's comfortable owning product decisions and implementing them.
Backend Mastery at Scale (C# / .NET): You have deep expertise designing scalable backend systems, RESTful APIs, and distributed architectures, primarily in C# / .NET, and you've worked with high-scale distributed systems in production. Strong API design fundamentals and system design are core to how you work. Roughly 80-90% of the work is backend; working on the frontend (React/TypeScript) is a welcome plus, not a requirement.
Enterprise Platform Fluency: You bring hands-on experience with the building blocks of modern enterprise APIs (MCP, CLIs, and OAuth) and know how to wield them to build secure, extensible integrations.
Cross-Team Leadership: You have a track record of leading projects across multiple teams. You can align with different areas and other stakeholders, manage cross-team contracts and dependencies, and keep complex, interconnected systems coherent.
Extreme Ownership & Operational Excellence: You own your services end-to-end (production operations, incident response, and on-call) and you're motivated by pushing reliability toward four nines. You write comprehensive tests, learn from incidents, and treat mature SLOs as a core engineering feature.
AI-Native Velocity: You leverage AI-powered tools (like Claude Code, Codex or GitHub Copilot) to accelerate delivery so you can focus your energy on high-value architecture and complex problem-solving.
Bonus points if you have: a track record of zero-downtime migrations on live systems; experience with metering, quota, or usage-data systems; worked in a compliance environment (SOC 2, ISO 27001, C5, or similar)
A Note on Our Hiring Process: DeepL hires for the Company , not just a specific team. We operate a Unified Engineering Pipeline . If you pass our bar, we will match you to the highest-priority role that fits your skillset—whether that is in Core Product, Platform, Voice, or Enterprise. We prioritize "Missionaries" who want to solve the biggest problems, wherever they live in the stack.

Diverse and internationally distributed team : joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.
Open communication, regular feedback : as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.

Founding Engineer / Lead Architect
ThrivoOS · Full-Time · Remote Europe · CET core hours
5–8+ years · Architecture ownership · Equity
About Thrivo
The independent wealth management industry is at an inflection point. AI, regulatory pressure, and a looming succession wave will determine which firms thrive — and which flounder — in the coming decade.
Thrivo Wealth Partners AG is a Swiss holding company based in Zug. Our model: partnering with founder-led independent wealth managers across the DACH region, helping them scale — organically and non-organically — and providing shared technology infrastructure. We are the long-term partner for future-ready wealth managers.

Christopher Kraft has accompanied numerous IWM transitions as an investment banker at Perella Weinberg Partners and in leading European wealth platforms. Felix Lobkowicz is a repeat founder — five companies, one IPO — and leads product and technology at Thrivo.

Finn Weise leads capital and governance with over a decade of experience building fintechs and financial platforms, previously at Morgan Stanley and European VC funds. On the board: Sebastian Henrichs, former CEO of FNZ Bank Germany — the leading wealth platform in the industry.
Behind Thrivo
Thrivo is backed by a circle of investors from the finance and fintech world — experienced operators, entrepreneurs, and family offices who understand this market and think long-term. A platform that promises long-term thinking to founders cannot itself be optimising for short-term returns.
The wealth management market in Germany and Switzerland is digitising — more slowly than other sectors, but with real momentum now. Thrivo is building the technology infrastructure that underpins this transformation: a platform for founder-led wealth managers that deploys compliance automation, AI-assisted processes, and modern data architecture in a way that until now has only been available to large institutions.
ThrivoOS is not another fintech dashboard. It is the operating system for a growing group of partner firms collectively managing several billion AUM. You build this — as the first technical full-time hire and the engineering lead.

You own the technical leadership of ThrivoOS. You set the architecture, coordinate the freelance senior engineer, and are the engineering constant in a project that bridges complex regulatory requirements — MiFID II, WpHG, BaFin — with modern AI infrastructure.
You work directly with Felix Lobkowicz (CTO-in-function) on product vision and technical direction. The most important architectural decisions are yours. The architecture and stack have not been finalised — you will define them together with Felix and Tech advisors based on your experience and what is right for the platform.
This is one of the few roles in DACH fintech where technical depth, genuine entrepreneurial ownership, and real equity participation come together.
What you own
Architecture & Infrastructure
· Design and build an event-sourced backend architecture — the structural foundation for regulatory-grade auditability under MiFID II and BaFin requirements
· Multi-tenant data architecture: one platform, many partner firms, strict data isolation and RBAC
· Batch data ingest pipeline from partner firm systems (custodian banks, PMS) — the Phase 1 data foundation
· Cloud infrastructure on AWS (Frankfurt region) — we use hyperscaler-grade tooling from day one
Workflows & AI
· Advisory workflow engine — regulated advisory processes as structured, automated flows with compliance write-back (Jahresgespräch, KYC/AML as Phase 1 scope)
· AI integration: automated meeting briefings, Gesprächsprotokoll generation, and document assembly for advisors via Gemini/RAG pipeline
· Compliance infrastructure: PII anonymisation before any LLM call, encryption at rest, consent management — structural, not bolt-on
Team & culture
· Coordinate the freelance senior full-stack engineer: architectural decisions, code quality, mutual peer review
· Technical point of contact for the product advisor and design partner advisors during pilot deployment
· Set the engineering culture from day one — we use agentic coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code) as standard. We cover the cost.
What Thrivo offers
Real equity participation
Thrivo offers a VSOP participation in the Holding. Structure and terms in conversation.
Ownership from day one
As the founding engineer, you set architecture standards and engineering practices the team will carry for years. You are not executing tickets — you are building the platform.
First-class team
Direct collaboration with Felix Lobkowicz (5 consumer companies founded, one through IPO), Christopher Kraft (Perella Weinberg Partners, 50+ IWM transactions), Finn Weise (Morgan Stanley, VC) and Sebastian Henrichs (former CEO FNZ Bank Germany).
We offer a competitive base salary and a meaningful VSOP participation in the Holding. Structure and exact terms in conversation.

· 5–8+ years of backend engineering in production systems — the right profile depends on depth of architecture experience, not years alone
· Event Sourcing and CQRS in practice — you have built it, not just read about it
· Domain-Driven Design — bounded contexts, aggregates, domain events
· PostgreSQL — schema design, query optimisation, pgvector
· AWS or comparable hyperscaler — production deployment, IAM, VPC, managed services
· Experience in regulated environments — fintech, banking, or insurance
· Senior enough to make architectural decisions independently and coordinate a freelance engineer
· CET timezone — daily overlap for peer review and fast alignment is required
What interests us additionally
· Go, TypeScript, or Java — we care about architecture patterns (Event Sourcing, CQRS, DDD), not the language on your CV. Experience with Go or willingness to work in Go is a plus.
· Familiarity with MiFID II, WpIG, or FINMA regulatory requirements
· Experience with graph-based workflow engines or saga patterns
· German is a plus, not a requirement

You have proven you can build complex systems. But you are not looking for the next job at a scale-up with 200 engineers where your work disappears into a microservice pipeline. You want to set the architecture, own the platform, and know that what you build is in production and making a real difference.
An early stage does not put you off — it attracts you, because you know the most important decisions are being made now. And you understand that equity in a platform that is positioning to be the market leader in a structurally underserved segment can be worth more than the next salary band.

At Cloudbeds, we're not just building software, we’re transforming hospitality. Our intelligently designed platform powers properties across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually.

From independent properties to hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges.

Since our founding in 2012, we've become the World's Best Hotel PMS Solutions Provider and landed on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again in 2024, but we're just getting started.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will help deliver an exceptional product experience to our customers all around the world. This could be for hotel guests, creating a user experience that makes travelers feel welcome, comfortable, and inspired to share the joy of travel with others.

Or it could be for our accommodation providers, building trusted, simple, easy-to-use features to support key aspects of their daily business. Helping nearly 10,000 properties globally to process billions in transactions every year.

About Apex.AI
Apex.AI is an international software company specializing in the development of safety-certified, developer-friendly, and scalable software for mobility systems, aiming to accelerate the transition to software-defined vehicles and mobility.

Founded in 2017 by Jan Becker and Dejan Pangercic, the company is headquartered in Palo Alto, California, with additional offices in Munich, Stuttgart, Gothenburg, Tokyo, and Pangyo.

To date, Apex.AI has raised over $75 million USD from world-class venture, financial and strategic investors including AGCO, Airbus Ventures, Canaan, Continental AG, Daimler Truck, HELLA Ventures, Jaguar Land Rover’s InMotion Ventures, LG Electronics, Lightspeed, Orillion, Toyota Ventures, Volvo Group Venture Capital and ZF.
The company’s flagship product, Apex.OS, consists of two core components: Apex.Grace and Apex.Ida.
Apex.Grace is an application runtime framework in the form of a software development kit (SDK). It provides a robust framework for developing real-time, reliable, and safe applications. Core APIs are based on ROS 2 APIs with numerous extensions enabling real-time execution, reliable performance, deployment into large fleets, system state management, safety, security, and much more. It is safety-certified to ISO 26262 ASIL D.
Apex.Ida is a communication middleware delivering optimal high-performance data transport across use cases. These use cases range from fully autonomous vehicles with dozens of high-resolution cameras to small signals with ultra-high frequencies in safety-critical domains. Its core is based on a shared memory data transport with connectors into DDS, SOME/IP, MQTT, CAN, and many more protocols, all abstracted into a single application-facing API.

Apex.Alan provides customers with a highly optimized and efficient software integration, development environment, build, test, and delivery process.
Apex.OS for V&V enables record and playback of very large and diverse data streams, both time- and data-deterministically, which is crucial for replay, analysis, and performance evaluation of complex autonomous systems.
Apex.AI’s software solutions are utilized across a diverse range of industries, including automotive, agriculture, medical, and defense sectors. The products enable developers to efficiently create and deploy safe, reliable, and high-performance applications, thereby accelerating the adoption of software-defined mobility systems.

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.
Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.
The Data Developer Experience team is looking for a Software Engineer to build core services for our Data Platform. The team builds the Data Control Plane, a Go-based internal Terraform- or Kubernetes-like platform which allows users and other services to configure and operate Data Platform infrastructure.
Our mission is to meet the massive data scaling needs of a global organization with a platform that is simple yet powerful, self-healing, agentic-safe, trustworthy, snappy, and cost efficient.

Documenting - you ensure high quality, curated markdown documentation for users, AI agents, and maintainers / on-call.
Operating - you strive for operational excellence with constant vigilance, proactivity, and on-call participation to ensure we provide a robust platform for business critical workloads.
Supporting - you understand the needs of diverse data platform users and guide them to golden paths.

You have a proven track record of designing, building, and operating large-scale distributed systems and/or platforms.
You bring deep experience with Go, but you possess a polyglot mindset and are happy to dive into Python or other languages when the problem calls for it.

You possess a strong foundational understanding of networking and security best practices.
You are familiar with data platform architecture and technologies, specifically columnar databases/storage and MPP engines.
You are passionate about Developer Experience and excel at balancing user needs with technical and platform constraints.
You actively leverage agentic coding as your preferred workflow to accelerate value delivery, while maintaining the critical eye needed to rigorously vet and secure code for robust systems.

A rare opportunity to join a near-greenfield project building state-of-the-art, robust, scalable foundations for the future.
Work in a Big Tech-adjacent environment with brilliant colleagues, modern tooling and practices, and large scale.

Founded in 2022 by former Zenly team members who lived the pain of broken SMS authentication firsthand, we're already serving fast-growing companies across Europe and are expanding into the US.
But authentication is only the starting point - we're building the platform for trust at scale, with an ambitious roadmap of market-defining products ahead.

We believe small, highly skilled teams outperform large, fragmented organizations, and we are intentional about staying focused on impact, quality, and speed.
